title: Brief the live optimizer from trusted feedback and explanations
description:
## Behavior and acceptance
Provide an injectable live optimizer interface with a scripted fake. Briefing includes eligible training item content/metadata, trusted votes and comments, errors, current rubric/tasks/examples and version. Do not send audit or scoreboard content, labels, errors or metrics to the optimizer.
Scenario: a vote with an explanation reaches the optimizer briefing; protected partition records do not. Inadequate class coverage is reported as waiting for labels, not silently declared successful optimization.

## Constraints
Native provider-neutral library only; no DSPy. The application does not implement a second flywheel. Optimizer proposes; code validates/applies; numerical fitting alone sets weights and calibration. Training, development, random audit and sealed scoreboard remain separated. No credentials or private article text in committed artifacts. Specs first with fake clients; live calls explicit and budgeted.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implementation progress: optimizer_agent.py now snapshots actual trusted training text/metadata, labels, explanation comments and current classifier configuration; excludes protected IDs and normalized-text matches; injected completion callable exposes exact prompts/replies/tool calls/model usage with safe failure diagnostics. Eight offline specs pass. Not complete: application live-client setup and durable UI transcript integration remain. No paid calls.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Current-state audit: eligible item text/metadata, labels, comments, current configuration, exact messages/replies/tool calls, protected-record refusal and waiting-for-coverage tests pass. Found remaining requirement gap: WorkspaceSession._pools builds LabeledItem.context from only human_feedback, and FeedbackBriefing.build only serializes comment from that context. Recorded initial_answer_value and correctness/error evidence therefore do not reach the optimizer briefing, even though durable FeedbackItem records contain the displayed decision. Keep this story open. Next implementation must attach only each eligible training record original pre-vote prediction/error, retain correction provenance, exclude development/audit/scoreboard, and preserve historical requests unchanged. No inferred predictions or paid rescoring just to create evidence.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented the missing original-prediction evidence in the reusable briefing contract. LabeledItem.initial_answer_value is separate from demonstration context. WorkspaceSession reads it from durable FeedbackItem records, including corrections and restarts; the Rich reviewer reads the linked pre-vote presentation. FeedbackBriefing exposes the recorded answer, current trusted label, explanation and agreement, with null for unavailable answers. Only eligible training rows enter this briefing; protected records remain rejected. Optimization-stage and round cache keys include recorded answers, while fit evidence and decision-response keys remain unchanged. Offline specs cover unknown answers, exact context separation, correction/restart, audit exclusion and stale optimizer-stage cache prevention. No paid calls, historical trace rewrites or experiment report. Full regression verification in progress.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Verification complete: 792 Python specs pass (16 existing pytest-bdd deprecation warnings). No live requests or production label changes. This closes the specifically identified missing error-evidence implementation gap; remaining wider application acceptance stays tracked on the board.
